risk_note: F1-08atb. apps/admin only (components/unknown-marker, pages/adjustments, pages/withdrawals). The result-unknown marker is held per submission: a settled answer releases only its own holding, the 关闭 prompt drops what it stood for without taking the claim from a submission still in flight; on 调账 the holder is bound to (Idempotency-Key, body), so a same-key same-body replay with a settled answer releases the original submission, and a 20901 releases only the refused body when another body holds the key. Stored marker stays {page, unknown, at}. No contract, money computation or db change.
